cabdb5b97a6b1b.s:
Assertion (A): Nameri became a National Park in 1998.
Reason (R): CA|TS was launched at the 1st Asian Parks Congress in Japan in 2013.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
cabdb5b97a6b1b.x: Nameri became a National Park in 1998 and CA|TS was launched in Japan in 2013; both are true, but the 2013 launch of CA|TS cannot explain a 1998 event.

cab48e82c1f0d2.s: Which group lists the CA|TS-accredited tiger reserves of Assam?
o: Satpura, Pench, Kanha, Panna and Bandhavgarh
cab48e82c1f0d2.x: The Assam entries in the 24-reserve CA|TS list are Manas, Kaziranga, Orang and Nameri; the other groups belong to other States.

ca05b9ed7072c2.s: Which group lists the CA|TS-accredited tiger reserves of Madhya Pradesh?
o: Satpura, Pench, Kanha, Panna and Bandhavgarh
ca05b9ed7072c2.x: Madhya Pradesh's CA|TS-accredited reserves are Satpura, Pench, Kanha, Panna and Bandhavgarh; the other groups are Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu and Assam.

ca69c9361f47da.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the CA|TS-accredited tiger reserves of Maharashtra?
o: Navegaon–Nagzira is in Madhya Pradesh's list, not Maharashtra's
ca69c9361f47da.x: Navegaon–Nagzira is listed among Maharashtra's CA|TS-accredited reserves, not Madhya Pradesh's; Pench, Melghat and Tadoba–Andhari are also in Maharashtra's list.

caade96818e808.s: According to the All India Tiger Estimation 2022, India's estimated tiger population was:
caade96818e808.x: The 2022 estimation put India's tiger population at 3,682; 3,167 was the camera-trapped minimum estimate.

cadfdc41c6a6da.s: Which organisation, headquartered in New Delhi, functions under the Ministry of Jal Shakti?
cadfdc41c6a6da.x: The Central Water Commission (estimated to date from 1945) is headquartered in New Delhi and works under the Ministry of Jal Shakti; Deltares is a Netherlands-based partner in the Kalpasar Project.

nfe8661eae63.s: India's estimated tiger population in 2022 was:
nfe8661eae63.x: The 2022 estimate placed India's tiger population at 3,682; 1,411 was the 2006 estimate and 3,167 the camera-trapped minimum.

ca33a52d01cf9b.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Global Methane Pledge – UNEP-led; India joined in 2019
Climate and Clean Air Coalition – Adopted in 2016
ca33a52d01cf9b.x: The Montreal Protocol dates to 1987. The Kigali Amendment was adopted in 2016, the Global Methane Pledge came at COP26 Glasgow (2021), and the CCAC is UNEP-led with India joining in 2019.

cac4ee807efca8.s: Which set lists India's measures against household and agricultural emission sources?
o: PMUY, GRAP, National AQI, SRI and Kigali Amendment
SRI, Global Methane Pledge, NAAQS, DSR and GRAP
PMUY, GOBARdhan, SRI, DSR and alternate wetting & drying
GOBARdhan, Montreal Protocol, DSR, Air Act and PMUY
cac4ee807efca8.x: The listed measures are PMUY, GOBARdhan, SRI, DSR and alternate wetting & drying; the other sets mix in air-quality rules or international instruments.

ca4c9f1090ac28.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's Himalayan hazard-mitigation measures?
o: National GLOF Risk Mitigation Programme – ₹150 crore; Arunachal Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Sikkim and Uttarakhand
NDMA Guidelines on GLOFs were issued in 2021
CWC and NRSC-ISRO monitoring from 2025 covers 2,843 water bodies, including 2,485 glacial lakes
National Landslide Risk Mitigation Project – ₹1,000 crore; 15 States
ca4c9f1090ac28.x: The NDMA Guidelines on GLOFs were issued in 2020, not 2021; 2021 relates to the Dam Safety Act.

ca09aa3a8ced1d.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Offshore Areas Mineral (Development and Regulation) Act was enacted in 2016.
2. The UN Ocean Decade extends from 2021 to 2030.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca09aa3a8ced1d.x: The Offshore Areas Mineral (D&R) Act was enacted in 2002, not 2016; the UN Ocean Decade covers 2021–2030.

ca345401d5a08d.s: Samudrayaan, under the Deep Ocean Mission (2021–2026), is:
ca345401d5a08d.x: Samudrayaan is a manned deep-sea mission under the Deep Ocean Mission for 2021–2026.

ca18db16887f2b.s: Under the Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules, 2016 framework, India is a party to which convention on hazardous wastes?
ca18db16887f2b.x: The Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules, 2016 are the relevant framework and India is a party to the Basel Convention.

cada0e4bb6280c.s: India's first high-altitude Snow Leopard Safari was launched at Leh on 7 October 2026 during:
cada0e4bb6280c.x: The safari was launched at Leh, Ladakh, on 7 October 2026 during Wildlife Week; International Snow Leopard Day falls on 23 October.

ca3b311a1cf4a4.s: Which captive-bred birds were released at Sam in the Desert National Park near Jaisalmer?
ca3b311a1cf4a4.x: Two captive-bred male Great Indian Bustards (Ardeotis nigriceps, Critically Endangered) were released at Sam in the Desert National Park.

ca5d0ce43af8c4.s: The new gecko Hemidactylus koyaorum was found in which location of Telangana?
ca5d0ce43af8c4.x: Hemidactylus koyaorum, named after the Koya tribe, was found in Pakhal Wildlife Sanctuary, Warangal; Nalgonda is linked with H. cairnicola.

ca48457205ee8d.s:
Consider the following statements about Didymocarpus nautiyalii:
1. It was found in Shi-Yomi district of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. It is named after Prof. Sunil Nautiyal, former Director of the G.B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca48457205ee8d.x: Both are true: the plant was found in Shi-Yomi district and honours Prof. Sunil Nautiyal, former Director of the G.B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment.

ca61192edd714f.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: SHAN Society and Ladakh Forest Department – Implementing bodies of the Snow Leopard Safari
Launch of the Snow Leopard Safari – International Snow Leopard Day
Ladakh's snow leopard population under SPAI 2024 – 477
Panthera uncia – Scientific name of the snow leopard
ca61192edd714f.x: The safari was launched on 7 October 2026 during Wildlife Week, not on International Snow Leopard Day (23 October); the other pairs are correct.

ca6ef4e69f6105.s:
Consider the following statements about the Desert National Park:
1. It lies in the Thar Desert and covers more than 3,160 sq km.
2. It receives more than 100 mm of rainfall.
3. It contains Jurassic fossils and extinct salt-lake beds.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca6ef4e69f6105.x: The park lies in the Thar Desert, covers over 3,160 sq km and has Jurassic fossils and salt-lake beds, but receives less than 100 mm of rainfall.

ca883f312dd242.s: The new gecko Hemidactylus cairnicola was found in which district of Telangana?
ca883f312dd242.x: Hemidactylus cairnicola was found in Nalgonda district; Warangal (Pakhal WLS) is linked with H. koyaorum.

ca144554a6a76c.s: The newly discovered plant Didymocarpus nautiyalii belongs to which family?
ca144554a6a76c.x: Didymocarpus nautiyalii is a Gesneriaceae herb of about 8 cm with leathery leaves and blue-violet flowers, growing on moist rocks above 1,000 m.

ca40861d509c25.s: Tso Kar, for which Ladakh launched a restoration initiative, is a:
o: High-altitude saline lake-wetland complex in southeastern Ladakh
High-altitude freshwater lake in western Ladakh
Glacial lake in the Zanskar valley
Riverine wetland on the Indus near Leh
ca40861d509c25.x: Tso Kar, also called the 'White Lake', is a high-altitude saline lake-wetland complex in southeastern Ladakh.

ca17da3f0d911f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2026 Swachh Vayu Survekshan awards?
o: The 5th awards were presented on 7 September 2026
Jammu Municipal Corporation was recognised in all three ward categories
Municipal wards were included for the first time in 2025
ca17da3f0d911f.x: Municipal wards were included for the first time in 2026, not 2025; the other statements are correct.

ca3b3be1de086b.s: Which of the following Swachh Vayu Survekshan category–winner pairs is correctly matched?
ca3b3be1de086b.x: Indore (2025) and Lucknow (2026) won the 10 lakh+ category; Amravati and Rourkela won 3–10 lakh, and Dewas and Kalinganagar won less than 3 lakh.

cace431417053a.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
cace431417053a.x: The Air Act dates to 1981; NAAQS is from 2009 (12 pollutants), the National AQI from 2015 and GRAP from 2017 for Delhi-NCR.

ca261de9c9eb3f.s:
Consider the following statements about the GI framework in India:
1. The GI Act was enacted in 1999.
2. It came into force on 15 September 2003.
3. GI registration is permanent and non-renewable.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca261de9c9eb3f.x: The GI Act dates from 1999 and came into force on 15 September 2003; registration is valid for 10 years and renewable, not permanent.

ca0c1382523b34.s:
Consider the following statements about NCAP monitoring:
1. PRANA monitors the NCAP.
2. SAMEER provides AQI for 292+ cities.
3. In March 2026 the network had 1,246 stations in 603 cities.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca0c1382523b34.x: PRANA monitors NCAP and SAMEER provides AQI for 292+ cities; the March 2026 network had 1,646 stations, not 1,246, in 603 cities.

ca643e331ec158.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Mercator projection is useful for navigation because constant compass bearings appear as straight lines.
2. The UNGA's promotion of equal-area maps changes international borders and sovereignty.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca643e331ec158.x: Constant compass bearings are straight lines on the Mercator projection; the UNGA-promoted change is only visual and leaves borders and sovereignty unaffected.

ca798cbc3bbed1.s: National Coastal Mission 2.0, with an outlay of ₹767 crore, covers which period?
ca798cbc3bbed1.x: NCM 2.0 is a Central Sector Scheme for 2025–26 to 2030–31 with ₹767 crore; 2021–22 to 2025–26 was the NCM 1.0 period.

ca74d012784b43.s:
Consider the following statements about the Pichavaram mangrove study:
1. It surveyed 302 households in 5 villages.
2. Most mangrove carbon is stored below ground in sediments.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca74d012784b43.x: Both are true: the study surveyed 302 households in 5 villages, and mangrove carbon is mostly stored below ground in sediments.

cabca0dc92fcaa.s: The Pichavaram Mangrove Forest, subject of an economic valuation and blue carbon study, is in which State?
cabca0dc92fcaa.x: The study 'Economic Valuation and Blue Carbon Assessment of Ecosystem Services in the Pichavaram Mangrove Forest' concerns Pichavaram in Tamil Nadu.

ca6923cc0a78ae.s: Haryana, with Chandigarh as its capital, was formed on:
ca6923cc0a78ae.x: Haryana was formed on 1 November 1966, and its capital is Chandigarh.

ca013611606cca.s:
Consider the following statements about the GI tag for Ambaji Mohanthal Prasad:
1. The GI tag was granted on 11 October 2026.
2. The certificate was issued on 11 October 2026, the first day of Sharadiya Navratri.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca013611606cca.x: The GI tag was granted on 8 October 2026; the certificate was issued on 11 October 2026, the first day of Sharadiya Navratri.

cab810a9101150.s: India's first port-based e-methanol plant is associated with which port authority?
cab810a9101150.x: The plant is associated with Deendayal Port Authority at Gandhidham–Kandla, Gujarat; Mumbai Port Authority is linked with Jawahar Dweep.

ca1d57956131c1.s: Which facility was declared India's first plastic-free oil terminal during Swachhata Abhiyan–2026?
ca1d57956131c1.x: The Mumbai Port Authority declared Jawahar Dweep Marine Oil Terminal India's first plastic-free oil terminal during Swachhata Abhiyan–2026.

ca7e4a85f06e0b.s: The Kalpasar Project MoUs signed at the 9th India International Water Week involved which Netherlands-based partners?
o: Rijkswaterstaat and Delft University of Technology
Deltares and Delft University of Technology
ca7e4a85f06e0b.x: The two tripartite MoUs involved the Central Water Commission, Gujarat's Kalpasar Department, Deltares and Delft University of Technology.

caaf42054f9bee.s: Which Chinese port, upgraded at a cost of $175.8 million, was buried in the August 2026 disaster?
caaf42054f9bee.x: Gyirong Port in Tibet, upgraded at $175.8 million, was buried in the August 2026 disaster.

ca78f93a0f3931.s: Mandar, the GI-tagged instrument of Jharkhand, is a:
o: Double-sided drum of red clay and leather
ca78f93a0f3931.x: Mandar is a double-sided barrel or cylindrical drum made of red clay and leather, linked to the tribal culture of the Chotanagpur Plateau.

cab85273956f24.s: In India's response to the Nepal rock–ice collapse, which pair is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Rivers mentioned – Gandak, Kosi and Ganga
States placed on alert – Bihar and Uttar Pradesh
Barrage kept under watch – Farakka Barrage
cab85273956f24.x: The barrage kept under watch was the Valmikinagar Barrage, not Farakka; the other pairs are correct.

ca476c9663fe6d.s: Which product was the first Geographical Indication registered in India (2004–05)?
ca476c9663fe6d.x: Darjeeling Tea was India's first GI, registered in 2004–05.

ca6d766e78ea8a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's e-waste and battery-waste rules?
o: E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 came into force on 1 April 2023
Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 permit landfilling and incineration of waste batteries
E-Waste Rules cover 106 categories, including solar PV
The EPR recycling target rises to 80% from 2027-28
ca6d766e78ea8a.x: The Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 ban landfilling and incineration of waste batteries; the other statements are correct.

cadf7fd1284ff4.s: The Tso Kar Wetland Complex in Ladakh, a Black-necked Crane habitat, was designated a Ramsar site in:
cadf7fd1284ff4.x: The Tso Kar Wetland Complex, comprising Tso Kar and Startsapuk Tso, was designated a Ramsar site in 2020.

ca4e4ff958d0ce.s: Anak Krakatau ('Child of Krakatau') rose from the caldera of the Krakatau eruption of:
ca4e4ff958d0ce.x: Anak Krakatau rose from the caldera of the 1883 Krakatau eruption.

ca134e458caf6b.s: Before the paddy harvest, Haryana's Parali Protection Force undertakes:
o: Promotion of Happy Seeder, Super Seeder and mulching
Field surveillance, drone monitoring and midnight patrols
Monitoring of PM2.5, PM10 and CO emissions
Operation of city air-quality monitoring stations
ca134e458caf6b.x: The force carries out field surveillance, drone monitoring and midnight patrols at district and block level; Happy Seeder, Super Seeder and mulching are promoted alternatives.

ca27637fd67a88.s:
Consider the following statements about the Global Innovation Index 2026:
1. It was based on six pillars.
2. Creative Outputs was not one of its pillars.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca27637fd67a88.x: Both are false: the GII 2026 had seven pillars, and Creative Outputs was one of them.

ca9d4c4fadd607.s: Which economy ranked first in the Global Innovation Index 2026 with a score of 66.7?
ca9d4c4fadd607.x: Switzerland ranked first in the GII 2026 with a score of 66.7.

ca68725ed3d28f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Travel and Tourism Development Index?
o: It was produced by the WEF with Zurich Insurance Group and covered 110 economies
Low travel cost and cultural resources contributed to India's performance
India ranked 41st, improving by nine places
Japan, the US, Spain, Australia and France were the top five
ca68725ed3d28f.x: India ranked 31st, not 41st, improving by nine places; the other statements are correct.

ca7387f70cea5c.s:
Consider the following statements about the Global Business Climate Survey 2026:
1. India ranked second among 41 markets.
2. India remained in the Top 3 for the fourth straight year.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7387f70cea5c.x: India ranked first among 41 markets, not second, and stayed in the Top 3 for the fourth straight year.

ca33aa38aec8c5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct in the context of the Lancet study on village-level SDG gaps in India?
o: No Indian village met several SDG indicators by 2021, including health insurance and women's bank accounts
The SDGs comprise 16 goals and 169 targets, to be achieved by 2030
Nearly all villages met the adolescent pregnancy target for girls aged 10–14
The study team included Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
ca33aa38aec8c5.x: The SDGs comprise 17 goals, not 16, with 169 targets to be achieved by 2030.

ca63979b82e8c4.s: As per the Global Gender Gap Index 2026, the world (69.2% gap closed) needs about how long to reach full parity?
ca63979b82e8c4.x: The world had closed 69.2% of the gender gap, and full parity was estimated to be about 120 years away.

ca933e37f06877.s: Which of the following was NOT identified as a challenge in the Global Business Climate Survey 2026?
ca933e37f06877.x: The reported challenges were administrative complexity, regulatory unpredictability and trade barriers; tax barriers were not among them.

n7e0ff2a1dce.s: Which institution is India's nodal body for improving its rank in the Global Innovation Index?
n7e0ff2a1dce.x: NITI Aayog is India's nodal body for improving the country's ranking in the Global Innovation Index.

ca389305d1a5ad.s:
Consider the following statements about the Annual Survey of Industries 2024–25:
1. It was released by MoSPI and covered organised manufacturing.
2. The number of factories fell from 2.67 lakh to 2.60 lakh.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca389305d1a5ad.x: MoSPI released the survey covering organised manufacturing; factories increased from 2.60 lakh to 2.67 lakh rather than falling.

cafbd71e18c9f5.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
cafbd71e18c9f5.x: The Aspirational Districts Programme was launched in January 2018 and covers 112 districts; the Blocks Programme began in January 2023 and NITI Aayog on 1 January 2015.

ca5015a31ce71b.s: Which district ranked first among Andhra Pradesh's 26 districts in the YouthPOWER rankings, with a score of 55?
ca5015a31ce71b.x: Visakhapatnam ranked first among AP's 26 districts in the YouthPOWER rankings of the AP State Handbook of Youth Opportunity, with a score of 55.

cab9fc723b24e9.s: In the India Electric Mobility Index 2025, which category–leaders pair is correctly matched?
o: Hilly and NE States – Delhi, Chandigarh, Goa
UTs / City States – Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu
Large States – Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu
cab9fc723b24e9.x: Large States were led by Maharashtra, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu; Hilly and NE States by Manipur, Tripura and Assam; UTs/City States by Delhi, Chandigarh and Goa.

ca6ea49fee411e.s: The Ministry of Jal Shakti was formed in 2019 by merging the Ministry of Water Resources with which ministry?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation
ca6ea49fee411e.x: The Jal Shakti Ministry was formed in 2019 by merging the Water Resources and Drinking Water and Sanitation ministries.

cab38d9a09f584.s: In the Living Planet Report 2026, which region–decline pair is correctly matched?
o: Latin America and the Caribbean – 95% decline
cab38d9a09f584.x: The report recorded declines of 95% in Latin America and the Caribbean, 80% in Africa and 49% in the Asia-Pacific.

cae8d6ceb584e8.s: In the FAO–Landscape Alliance report 'Forests for Food', which pair is correctly matched?
o: Maximum share of rural income in some regions – Up to 80%
Share of daily protein from wild foods in remote communities – Up to 20%
cae8d6ceb584e8.x: Over 5 billion people depend on forests; forests give up to 20% of rural income, 50,000+ wild species are used (10,000+ eaten) and wild foods give up to 80% of daily protein in remote communities.

cad2b4bcf6dc53.s: Who is the Director-General of the Rome-headquartered FAO, associated with the 'Forests for Food' report?
cad2b4bcf6dc53.x: The FAO is headquartered in Rome and its Director-General is Qu Dongyu.

ca24dd0b0afb40.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Global Coral Reef Monitoring Network – Established in 1995 under the International Coral Reef Initiative
ca24dd0b0afb40.x: The GCRMN was established in 1995 under the International Coral Reef Initiative; Lakshadweep has atolls and the Andaman and Nicobar reefs are fringing reefs.

cab04321b34b3b.s: According to The Lancet Public Health study, how many second-hand smoke deaths did India record in 2023?
cab04321b34b3b.x: India recorded 3,25,600 second-hand smoke deaths in 2023, up from 2,17,700 in 1990.

ca621dd97e4dbf.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the World Development Report 2026?
o: It covers about 5.6 billion people in low- and middle-income countries
It identifies Three Cs: Capabilities, Concentration and Complements
It recommends that every low- and middle-income country build frontier AI from scratch
ca621dd97e4dbf.x: The report explicitly does not recommend building frontier AI from scratch; the other statements describe it correctly.

cacf740ef2d59e.s: In the context of the UNCTAD Trade and Development Report 2026, which pair is correctly matched?
cacf740ef2d59e.x: UNCTAD was established in 1964 and the first Trade and Development Report came in 1981; China recorded 4,201 and India 1,416 measures during 2008–21.

ca54db6115e111.s: How many pillars does the IndiaAI Mission have?
ca54db6115e111.x: The IndiaAI Mission has 7 pillars, including Compute, AIKosh datasets, FutureSkills, Startup Financing and Safe & Trusted AI.

ca6b72f3b379a7.s: In 2025, the extreme poverty line reported through the Poverty and Inequality Platform was revised to:
ca6b72f3b379a7.x: The extreme poverty line was revised in 2025 to USD 3.00 per day in 2021 PPP, with data provided through the Poverty and Inequality Platform.

caf5e76c87b581.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Electricity's share of global final energy could reach 40% by 2035.
2. The International Energy Agency was established in 1975 and is headquartered in Geneva.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf5e76c87b581.x: Both are false: electricity's share could reach 35% by 2035, and the IEA dates from 1974 and is based in Paris.

ca25c9c4e09b26.s: The National Statistical Office was formed in 2019 by merging:
o: CSO and Registrar General of India
ca25c9c4e09b26.x: The NSO was formed in 2019 by merging the Central Statistics Office and the National Sample Survey Office.

cac08b80e07711.s: How many cybercrime cases did the NCRB report for India in 2024?
cac08b80e07711.x: The NCRB reported 1,01,928 cybercrime cases in 2024, up from 86,420 in 2023.

ca49aa61597d3f.s: According to the YouthPOWER findings, which State recorded the fastest growth in young women's banking and digital access?
ca49aa61597d3f.x: Andhra Pradesh recorded the fastest growth in young women's banking and digital access among all States surveyed.

caf4d6a5089fa9.s:
Consider the following statements about the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control:
1. It was adopted in 2005.
2. It came into force in 2005.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf4d6a5089fa9.x: The WHO FCTC was adopted in 2003 and came into force in 2005.

ca05440ec13171.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Anne Carson of Canada received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature.
2. The 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature was also awarded to Anne Carson.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca05440ec13171.x: Anne Carson won the 2026 Literature prize for creative writing exploring new forms; the 2025 winner was László Krasznahorkai.

cacc5ddb41148f.s: Sachin Tendulkar holds which UNICEF position?
o: UNICEF East Asia and Pacific Regional Ambassador
cacc5ddb41148f.x: Sachin Tendulkar is the UNICEF South Asia Regional Ambassador; UNICEF India Celebrity Advocate is the role given to Smriti Mandhana.

ca25cbbcdd0838.s:
Consider the following statements about the Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Jan Seva Puraskar 2026:
1. NCSC Chairman Kishor Makwana received it on 9 September 2026 in New Delhi.
2. He was nominated for the award by the NCSC.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca25cbbcdd0838.x: Makwana received the award on 9 September 2026 at the 16th Sansad Ratna Awards in New Delhi; he was nominated by the Prime Point Foundation, not the NCSC.

ca5387f862bcfa.s: In which city were the AGU 2026 awards, including those to Roxy Mathew Koll and Neelima Satyam, presented?
ca5387f862bcfa.x: The AGU 2026 awards were presented in San Francisco; Washington, D.C. is AGU's headquarters.

ca56e9eb2ee4eb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Rajbhasha awards and Hindi Diwas 2026?
o: The Department of Financial Services won First Prize in the Rajbhasha Kirti Awards 2025–26 (ministries under 300 staff)
The awards were given at the 6th All India Official Language Conference, Vashi, Navi Mumbai
Article 343 provides for Hindi in the Roman script
DARPG received the Rajbhasha Utkrishtata Samman 2025–26
ca56e9eb2ee4eb.x: Article 343 provides for Hindi in the Devanagari script, not Roman; the other statements are correct.

ca6d3a3ae8158a.s: Which Nobel Prize category–awarding body pair is correctly matched?
o: Physics – Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet
Peace – Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences
Physiology or Medicine – Norwegian Nobel Committee
ca6d3a3ae8158a.x: Literature is awarded by the Swedish Academy; Physics by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, Medicine by the Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet and Peace by the Norwegian Nobel Committee.

ca47575bb09bd2.s: About the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, which pair is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Prize amount – 12 million SEK (about US$1.2 million)
Norwegian Nobel Committee – Five members appointed by the Storting
ca47575bb09bd2.x: The Peace Prize ceremony is held in Oslo on 10 December 2026, not Stockholm; the other pairs are correct.

ca0ec7e30f435a.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Academy Awards were first held in 1929.
2. The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences is headquartered in Beverly Hills.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0ec7e30f435a.x: Both are true: the Academy Awards began in 1929 and the Academy is headquartered in Beverly Hills.

caf4d658164289.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about freedom fighter and socialist P. Vasu?
o: He died at Cheruvannur in Kozhikode
He was 103 at the time of his death
He was inspired by Gandhi's speech in Kozhikode in 1934
caf4d658164289.x: P. Vasu died on 8 October 2026, not 10 October; he was 103 and died at Cheruvannur, Kozhikode.
